title: 第 58 章 暖男排狗后面行不行第 57 章 没想到我竟然会输给他
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: 交手结束之后苏婉清退到了一旁，她站在原地脸上没什么表情可心中却翻涌着一股难以言说的情绪。
她在心里反复想着刚才那一幕，她居然被陈默一招就击败了而且还是在那么多师姐妹面前。
修炼了这么多年居然还打不过一个刚拜入师门没多久的外门弟子，这种事传出去她的脸面往哪搁啊。
只见苏婉清咬了咬嘴唇手握着剑柄，她越想越觉得难堪可又不能表现出来只能强撑着站在那里。
周围的师姐妹们可没有注意到她的情绪，她们全都围在陈默身边你一言我一语的说着。
“陈默师弟你刚才那一招雷法真的太厉害了，苏师姐连一招都接不住。”
“你是怎么练的能不能教教我们，我们也想学那种厉害的雷法。”
“难怪沈长老这么看重你，你的天赋真的太强了。”
“以后在内门可没人敢惹你了，连苏师姐都不是你的对手。”
眼前的师姐妹们的眼中全是崇拜和羡慕，她们看着陈默的眼神当中也是透露出一些崇拜和羡慕。
只见沈清璇站在一旁看着这一幕然后点了点头，她的脸上露出了满意的笑容。
“陈默你做得不错。”沈清璇说道。
“为师果然没有看错你，你的进步比为师预想的还要快。”
“你们都看到了吗，陈默虽然入门最晚但他的修炼速度却比你们都快。”
“你们应该向他学习，而不是整天在那里偷懒。”
那些师姐妹们听到沈清璇的话之后纷纷点头，她们看着陈默的眼神更加崇拜了。
随后等沈清璇又说了几句话之后便转身离开了，她的步伐从容背影带着几分满意的态度。
等她走远之后师姐妹们更加放开了，她们围着陈默问东问西叽叽喳喳的也是说个不停。
当陈默被她们围在中间也是有些哭笑不得，他在心里想着这些女人一个个的反应也太大了吧。
而苏婉清站在一旁看着这一幕心里暗暗有些生气，她在心里想着这些人以前都是围着她转的现在全跑去找陈默了。
只听她冷哼一声然后转身离开了弟子广场，连招呼都没打一声。
几个时辰的时间很快就过去了，一眨眼的功夫过去天色渐渐暗了下来。
陈默从弟子广场离开之后准备去一趟外门看看周玄，他穿过内门的走廊朝着通往外门的方向走去。
可他刚走到半路上的时候就看到一个身影拦在了前方不远处，正是周牧之。
这时周牧之的脸色不太好看，而且他的眼神中带着几分怒意和不满。
“陈默你给我站住。”周牧之开口道。
随后陈默停下脚步看着他不过脸上没有什么表情，他在心里想着这个人怎么又来了。
“有事。”陈默淡淡道。
“自然是有事。”周牧之说道。
“听说你今天在弟子广场上当着那么多师姐妹的面打败了你苏师妹，还让她当众难堪。”
“你知不知道她是什么身份，你居然让她在那么多人面前下不来台。”
这时陈默看着他心中觉得有些无语，他在心里想着这人怎么什么都要管。
“那是师父安排的比试。”陈默说道。
“我只是按照师父的要求出手而已，她自己接不住难道还要怪我。”
“你……”周牧之被噎了一下脸色更加难看了。
“就算你师父安排了你也不该下那么重的手，你明明可以让着她的。”
“让着她。”陈默说道。

;;
After the fight, Su Wanqing stepped aside. She stood there with no expression on her face, but there was an unspeakable emotion in her heart.
She thought over and over in her mind about the scene just now. She was actually defeated by Chen Mo in one move and in front of so many fellow apprentices.
After practicing for so many years, she still couldn't beat an outer disciple who had just joined the sect. Where would she put her face if word of this came out?
Su Wanqing bit her lip and held the hilt of the sword in her hand. The more she thought about it, the more embarrassed she felt, but she couldn't show it and could only stand there.
The junior sisters around her didn't notice her emotions. They all gathered around Chen Mo and talked to each other.
"Junior Brother Chen Mo, the lightning move you just made was really too powerful. Senior Sister Su couldn't even catch a single move."
"Can you teach us how you practice? We also want to learn that powerful thunder technique."
"No wonder Elder Shen values you so much. Your talent is really too strong."
"No one in the inner sect will dare to mess with you from now on. Even Senior Sister Su is no match for you."
The eyes of the junior sisters in front of them were full of admiration and envy, and they also revealed some admiration and envy in their eyes when they looked at Chen Mo.
I saw Shen Qingxuan standing aside watching this scene and then nodded, with a satisfied smile on her face.
"Chen Mo, you did a good job." Shen Qingxuan said.
"My teacher really did not misjudge you. Your progress is faster than my teacher expected."
"Have you all seen that although Chen Mo got started the latest, his cultivation speed is faster than all of you."
"You should learn from him instead of being lazy all day long."
The junior fellow apprentices nodded after hearing Shen Qingxuan's words, and they looked at Chen Mo with even more admiration.
Then, after Shen Qingxuan said a few more words, she turned around and left, her steps calm and somewhat satisfied.
After she walked away, the sisters became more relaxed. They surrounded Chen Mo asking questions and chattering non-stop.
When Chen Mo was surrounded by them, he was a little bit dumbfounded. He thought in his heart that the reactions of these women must be too great.
Su Wanqing stood aside and watched this scene, feeling secretly angry. She was thinking that these people who used to surround her were all running to find Chen Mo.
She just snorted coldly and turned around to leave the disciples' square without even saying hello.
A few hours passed quickly, and the sky gradually darkened in the blink of an eye.
After Chen Mo left the Disciples Square, he was going to the outer gate to see Zhou Xuan. He walked through the corridor of the inner gate and walked towards the outer gate.
But when he was halfway there, he saw a figure blocking the road not far ahead. It was Zhou Muzhi.
At this time, Zhou Muzhi's face didn't look good, and there was a bit of anger and dissatisfaction in his eyes.
"Chen Mo, stop here." Zhou Muzhi said.
Then Chen Mo stopped and looked at him without any expression on his face. He was thinking in his mind why this person was here again.
"Something's wrong." Chen Mo said calmly.
"Of course something happened." Zhou Muzhi said.
"I heard that you defeated your junior sister Su in the Disciple Square today in front of so many junior sisters, and even embarrassed her in public."
"Do you know who she is? You actually made it difficult for her to stand down in front of so many people."
At this time, Chen Mo looked at him and felt a little speechless. He thought in his heart why this man had to take care of everything.
"That was a competition arranged by Master." Chen Mo said.
"I just acted according to Master's request. Why should she blame me if she can't catch it herself?"
"You..." Zhou Muzhi choked and his face became even more ugly.
"Even if your master arranged it, you shouldn't be so harsh. You can obviously let her go."
"Let her go." Chen Mo said.
